stories.title: Skubal Begins California Meetings Next Week — Mets/Dodgers Primary Bidders

x_posts.label: Post 2-1
x_posts.text:
Corbin Skubal heads to California next week to meet with teams.

AP: 6 teams in. ESPN: Mets + Dodgers are the primary bidders.

Heyman: Mets "probably" the favorite. Blue Jays newly in. Cubs out.

The biggest pitching market in a generation is heating up. #MLB

x_posts.label: Post 2-2
x_posts.text:
Skubal projections: 8yr/$352M.

That would be $44M AAV — shattering Yamamoto's $27M AAV pitcher record.

He turns 30 on Nov 20. CBA expires Dec 1. The window is closing fast.

#MLB #Mets #Dodgers

article.headline: Corbin Skubal Free Agency: Mets and Dodgers Lead as California Meetings Begin

stories.title: Seager Trade Market — Full NTC Means It's His Decision

x_posts.label: Post 3-1
x_posts.text:
Rangers are shopping Corey Seager.

But here's the catch: Seager has a full no-trade clause (10&5 rights).

Any trade only happens if he says yes. And after elbow surgery + a career-low .227 season in 2026 — that's a big ask.

#Rangers #MLB

x_posts.label: Post 3-2
x_posts.text:
Yankees want Corey Seager at third base, per Heyman.

His contract: 5 years/$155M+ remaining. His 2026: career lows across the board.

Sherman is skeptical. Yankees fans should probably be, too. 🤔

#Yankees #MLB

article.headline: Rangers Exploring Corey Seager Trade — But It's His Decision

stories.title: Teruaki Sato Posted — Five-Plus Teams, Dec 16 Deadline

x_posts.label: Post 4-1
x_posts.text:
Teruaki Sato — 2026 NPB Triple Crown winner — is on the market.

.308/.385/.613. 39 home runs. Age 25.

Confirmed bidders: Mets, Yankees, Dodgers, Phillies, Padres.

Contract range: $80M to $180M. Dec 16 deadline. #MLB

x_posts.label: Post 4-2
x_posts.text:
The CBA expires Dec 1. The Teruaki Sato posting window closes Dec 16.

If there's a lockout, that window PAUSES until a new CBA is done.

Teams have about 19 days to get this done or wait months. #MLB #FreeAgency

article.headline: Teruaki Sato Posted: MLB Teams Race Before CBA Lockout Pauses Window
